pre_production.description: Local, model, and sandbox-verifiable checks required before deployment. For provider and lifecycle gates, this phase validates local adapter contracts, authorization boundaries, fail-closed behavior, and sandbox-safe paths only; it does not claim live production connectivity.

stage_45.name: Final Pre-Production Production-Readiness Verification
stage_45.purpose: Evaluate the complete pre-production evidence set and authorize deployment only when all 44 checks pass.
pass_conditions: Exactly 44 unique pre-production checks are present.
All 44 checks have PASSED status at LOCAL, MODEL, or SANDBOX scope appropriate to the check.
Evidence is current, commit-matched, hash-verified, and reproducible.
Release artifact and deployment target are identified and validated.
No unresolved pre-production integrity, security, or policy blocker remains.
must_not_depend_on: Post-deployment monitoring or whole-product production exercise

post_production.description: Checks that require a deployed production or production-like target. These checks cannot block Stage 45 because they cannot exist until after deployment.

checks.name: Central Failure Diversion Preserves Evidence & Executes Rollback
Live Neon and PayPal provider connectivity/authentication
Deployment health, readiness, telemetry, and monitoring
Failure diversion, rollback, and recovery exercise
Integrated SolveX verification including Daisy 54-node graph, node handoffs, JIT generation, packaging, distribution, and recovery

stage_46.name: Final Consolidated Truth-Boundary and Proof Closure
pass_conditions: Stage 45 passed and its evidence is preserved.
Every required post-production check passed with production or approved-staging evidence.
All evidence is commit/environment matched and hash verified.

rules: Never promote EXTERNAL_PROVIDER_REQUIRED, PENDING, or BLOCKED to PASSED.
Local, model, and sandbox evidence cannot establish production connectivity.
Stage 45 consumes only the 44 pre-production results.
Stage 46 consumes Stage 45 and all required post-production results.
No post-production result may be a prerequisite of Stage 45.
